story.soThat: lookahead bias and bar alignment issues are detected

tasks.task: Implement Layer1DataComparator class Add class to rustybt/validation/comparators.py Define __init__(self, tolerances: dict) Define compare(rustybt_logs, backtrader_logs) method Return list[Discrepancy]

Implement lookahead bias detection Filter logs by layer="data" Extract data_accessed_timestamp from each event Compare against current_bar_timestamp Create Discrepancy for any future access Mark as CRITICAL - zero tolerance

Implement bar alignment comparison Filter for event="bar_received" events Compare bar counts between frameworks Compare timestamps with window tolerance Compare OHLCV values with decimal tolerance Report misaligned bars as Discrepancy
Implement values_match() helper Accept two values and decimal_places Round both values to decimal places Return boolean for equality check
Create pytest test file Create tests/validation/test_layer_1_data.py Add @pytest.mark.layer_1_data marker Register marker in pytest.ini
Write comprehensive unit tests Test lookahead bias detection Test bar count mismatch detection Test bar alignment with tolerance Test OHLCV value comparison Test no discrepancies for matching data

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Lookahead bias detected when data_accessed_timestamp > current_bar_timestamp
Bar alignment comparison using timestamp_window_ms tolerance
OHLCV value comparison using price_decimal_places tolerance
Bar count comparison exact match required (bar_count_tolerance=0)
pytest test file exists with @pytest.mark.layer_1_data marker
Unit tests verify lookahead bias, bar alignment, and OHLCV comparison

doc.title: Architecture - Validation Layers
doc.snippet: Layer 1 Data Handling: lookahead bias detection, bar alignment, data integrity. Events: bar_received. CRITICAL layer for temporal correctness.

doc.title: Architecture - Comparison Engine
doc.snippet: compare_layer function filters logs by layer, applies layer-specific comparator, returns discrepancies. LAYER_COMPARATORS registry maps layer name to comparator class.

doc.title: PRD - Data Handling Validation
doc.snippet: System can compare data handling logs to detect lookahead bias violations. System can compare data handling logs to detect bar alignment discrepancies.

doc.title: PRD - Temporal Integrity
doc.snippet: No Lookahead Bias: Test must prove strategies cannot access future data. Bar Alignment: OHLCV bars must align correctly across timestamps.

doc.title: Epic 4 - Story 4.3 Specification
doc.section: Story 4.3: Implement Layer 1 Data Handling Comparator
doc.snippet: Lookahead bias is CRITICAL - zero tolerance. Bar alignment uses timestamp_window_ms. OHLCV comparison uses price_decimal_places.

file.reason: Target module to implement Layer1DataComparator class
Prerequisite: log parser used to load logs for comparison

constraints.constraint: Lookahead bias has ZERO tolerance - any future data access is an error
Log schema requires timestamp, layer, event fields
Temporal integrity is CRITICAL for backtesting validity
Layer 1 must be completed before Layers 2-5 can be implemented

ideas.idea: test_detect_lookahead_bias_violation - verify discrepancy when future data accessed
test_detect_lookahead_bias_no_violation - verify no discrepancy for past data
test_bar_alignment_within_tolerance - verify no discrepancy within window
test_bar_alignment_exceeds_tolerance - verify discrepancy when exceeds window
test_ohlcv_values_match - verify OHLCV comparison with decimal places
test_ohlcv_values_mismatch - verify discrepancy for mismatched OHLCV
test_bar_count_mismatch - verify discrepancy when bar counts differ
test_bar_count_exact_match - verify no discrepancy for same count
test_layer_1_full_comparison - end-to-end test with rustybt and backtrader logs
